messages.content: My reading just came in at 171/101. That's higher than it's been
Got it—logging that now. That's flagged so I'm escalating to our nurse.
How long will they take to get back to me?
Median response time is 31 hours. Might be sooner, might be a bit later depending on volume.
What should I do in the meantime?
I can't give medical advice, that's for the nurse. But I can say don't change your medication without talking to them first.
Gotcha, I'll wait to hear from them
Sounds good. Next weekly check-in is Thursday. Thanks for staying on top of this.
